design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER - task 1 of cleaning_and_damage_fee_assessments (env_0056_ride_hailing_platform). Every figure below comes from the verification run quoted in section 12.

0. DRAW AND SCOPE. `draw_counts.py <diff> --task 1` printed {"task": 1, "prerequisite_problems": 3, "problems": 4, "factor_counts": [4, 4, 5, 5]}: damage_ext_upheld_level_correction_fee 4, damage_ext_level_correction_refund 4, damage_ext_repair_schedule_estimate 5, damage_ext_damage_fee_on_approval 5. Occupied by task 0: the cleaning-family pre-charge writes (move-down at review, photo upload, partner work-order price, cleaning-fee approval) and their four policies and tools. This task claims the remaining, disjoint space: the receipt-based damage family (the driver's schedule estimate, the damage-fee approval) and the post-charge correction family (correcting the level of a charged and upheld fee, the level-difference refund). Together the two tasks cover all eight extended policies; no tool or policy is shared.

1. BASE DEFECTS ROUTED AROUND (declared, as in task 0). The damage fee charge and the partial refund are the only money writes this difficulty can make; their event-model triggers post the driver's payout credit or clawback in the earnings category, which this difficulty may not write, so the tools write the damage side only. Reversals and full refunds carry the mixed-authority service-animal gate that cannot be bound and are not used.

2. WHY THIS IS A GOOD TEST. The driver asks only for his damage fee to be approved. The agent must read the damage-fee approval policy to learn that (i) the fee is fixed only once the repair amount on file is within the schedule tolerance of the Wayfare repair schedule estimate, which the shop estimate is not (912.40 > 867.78), so the schedule estimate (723.15, from the trip's ride option and market) must be filed, and only the driver can file it; and (ii) the fee is charged only after each earlier charged fee of the rider stands at a level whose entry gate lists its category and, where that level is below the charge level, carries a refund booked at the level held, which sends the agent to the rider's July cleaning fee: trash_or_debris held at Level 3 although only Levels 1 and 2 list it. That assessment must first be corrected (fee standing 31.87, from the ledger of charge and earlier refund) and then refunded (151.29). Only then is the approval fee 923.43 computed. The July record is a reviewer's error the policy adjudicates: a careless agent trusts the upheld Level 3.

3. PROBLEM-TREE CARD. Root damage_ext_damage_fee_on_approval (approve_damage_fee_charge_55ca59de, agent). Prerequisites: damage_ext_repair_schedule_estimate (file_schedule_repair_estimate_16065485, USER), damage_ext_level_correction_refund (refund_level_difference_30807e99, agent), damage_ext_upheld_level_correction_fee (correct_upheld_fee_level_42a82f5f, agent).
 E1 approval <- schedule estimate, value_input, state form, gate amount_on_file: "A damage fee charged on approval is fixed only after the repair amount on file is no more than the Wayfare repair schedule estimate for the repair increased by the schedule tolerance." False at opening: f4d13256-20ff-45c0-8d68-7e88992126ea.repair_receipt_amount 912.40 > 723.15 x 1.20. Only the schedule filing changes a damage report's repair amount on file. Deletion: 902.62 instead of 923.43.
 E2 approval <- refund, state_gate, state form, gate damage_events.fee_level: "A damage fee is charged to a rider only after each earlier charged fee assessment of that rider is held at a level whose entry gate lists its incident category and, where that level is below the level its fee was charged at, carries a level-difference refund booked at the level it is held at." False at opening: ab9d1800-719f-4e41-b176-6be78fd5bf8d held at Level 3 (gate omits trash_or_debris). After the correction alone it is still false: Level 2 is below the charge level (Level 4, row e1bd226a-b63e-46d9-8d0e-3204dd012e5e) and the only refund (e088d5fd-2225-4a4f-b125-feb110772a73) is booked at Level 3. Only the refund write books a partial refund at the level held, and the refund rule waits on the correction, so the derivation reads: state false -> the write that books a level-difference refund -> which waits on a gate-listing level -> the correction. Deletion: no Level 2 refund row, July net fee stays 164.16 (gold 12.87).
 E3 refund <- correction, value_input, state form, gate to_flat: "A level-difference refund is worked out only after the assessment is held at a level whose entry gate lists its incident category." False at opening: ab9d1800-719f-4e41-b176-6be78fd5bf8d at Level 3. Only the correction write moves a charged fee's level. Deletion: refund 19.00 instead of 151.29.
 Directions: 'fixed only after' (affirmative), 'charged ... only after' (affirmative), 'worked out only after' (affirmative); the difficulty's other policies carry negated sentences ('is not priced until', 'is not fixed until'). Topological order: {schedule filing} || {correction -> refund} -> approval; value_input edges E1, E3 (2 >= max(3-1,1)). The two branches commute (order_uniqueness). user_scenario names no prerequisite; tools validate nothing.

4. FACTOR CARDS (tier -> figure with that factor at baseline).
 damage_ext_repair_schedule_estimate (723.15; baseline 428.02): parts_tier [trip f227a3fe-4f6a-4c6a-b9d3-feef1149430d Wayfare Black -> 1.45] 648.87; metro_labor_rate [PHX -> 108.00] 687.15; paint_method (method) [exterior on Wayfare Black -> blend 0.8 h x 2 panels x refinish rate 108.00 = 172.80] 635.35; parts_tax [Arizona -> 8.6%] 720.18; sensor_calibration [exterior AND luxury option -> 95.00] 628.15. Multi-source: sensor_calibration (level AND ride option). Cross-difficulty: all read the trip (product of the fares difficulty). Near-miss: the rider's profile home_market is LAS while the reported trip started in PHX; the rule reads the trip's market, and a reader using the home market prices the high-cost labor rate and the Nevada parts tax (742.67).
 damage_ext_upheld_level_correction_fee (31.87; baseline 60.00): carried_fee (method) [ledger: charge e1bd226a-b63e-46d9-8d0e-3204dd012e5e 270.00 - refund e088d5fd-2225-4a4f-b125-feb110772a73 105.84 = 164.16 > 100.00 -> x 60/100 = 98.496] 0.00; lost_time_removal (method) [Level 3 offline -> Level 2 not, cleaning documents 29a1f1ff-ec4f-4cc1-8436-accac6783c37/24614470-8348-470c-b6a9-5488aca55e69 dated 2026-07-18, drop-off 2026-07-17 -> 2 x 30.00] 81.55; correction_credit [earlier refund on the charge -> 10%] 35.42; overcharge_age_credit [67 days -> 8%] 34.65. Near-miss: the second cleaning receipt is the same day as the first, so the removal stays two days.
 damage_ext_level_correction_refund (151.29; baseline 40.00): refund_base (method) [earlier refund exists -> 270.00 - 105.84 - 31.87 = 132.29] 59.00; refund_pass_goodwill [f4f5f18a-4489-4342-992d-f2189962af71 Wayfare Pass Monthly -> 5.00] 146.29; refund_trip_volume [9cc63757-1b9f-4a85-aa11-b1239a7e68a7, 419991d7-e17a-4cbe-8319-afe46c686b6e: 2 within six months -> 4.00] 147.29; recontact_goodwill [closed 2026-08-03, 52 days -> 10.00] 141.29. Near-miss: the level moved from is Level 3 (latest refund), not Level 4 (the charge).
 damage_ext_damage_fee_on_approval (923.43; baseline 723.15): estimate_settlement [no receipt, 2 estimates -> 0.95] 958.51; damage_lost_time (method) [exterior repair on Wayfare Black -> per calendar day, 2026-09-20 through the latest ledger estimate 2026-09-24 = 5 x 55.00; other exterior repairs take one day, interior repairs none] 656.68; vehicle_damage_cap [Wayfare Black -> 1000.00] 717.80; damage_pass_goodwill [Pass Monthly -> 10.00] 933.13; damage_trip_volume [2 trips -> 3%] 951.99. Near-miss: the rider also holds a Wayfare Pass Plus Annual (card partner) cancelled 2025-07-31; the goodwill ladder reads the membership in active status (Monthly), and a reader taking the Plus plan applies the Plus-tier 25.00 (908.88).
Tiers rest on seeded rows (trips, ledgers, membership); no stamp field decides any tier.

5. BASE-INVARIANT CARD. Schedule filing (evidence_submit/update): evidence_open_status - f4d13256-20ff-45c0-8d68-7e88992126ea under_review; submissions 1 of 3; evidence deadline 2026-09-28 open. Correction (reclassify): damage_level_classification (gate rule; down only) and damage_evt_refunds (a move after upheld is followed by a refund) - policy scope. Refund (partial refund): reclassified_after_charge - ab9d1800-719f-4e41-b176-6be78fd5bf8d status upheld at the call, after the step-13 move. Approval: below_report_threshold - d5034228-2692-439f-8fb1-b0d01a9a2dee has 1 report in the 30 days ending 2026-09-21 (the July report is outside); approved_assessment; not_shared_trip - f227a3fe-4f6a-4c6a-b9d3-feef1149430d Wayfare Black. No time gate governs these subjects.

6. BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD. Target f4d13256-20ff-45c0-8d68-7e88992126ea on trip f227a3fe-4f6a-4c6a-b9d3-feef1149430d (rider 1603352c-a3c5-47d4-af9b-568f9fd131f4, driver d5034228-2692-439f-8fb1-b0d01a9a2dee, agreement 8968d399-1561-4299-8a92-257e62ec7ed5); its ledger row 1006d12c-2012-4679-ae14-0e8afd143fb7. Earlier assessment ab9d1800-719f-4e41-b176-6be78fd5bf8d on trip b465854a-267c-44d1-a2c4-49411b5cd614: rows 29a1f1ff-ec4f-4cc1-8436-accac6783c37, 24614470-8348-470c-b6a9-5488aca55e69 (cleaning documents), e1bd226a-b63e-46d9-8d0e-3204dd012e5e (charge 270.00, the original_event_id of the refund), e088d5fd-2225-4a4f-b125-feb110772a73 (earlier refund 105.84). The refund names e1bd226a-b63e-46d9-8d0e-3204dd012e5e; no other charge exists on ab9d1800-719f-4e41-b176-6be78fd5bf8d.

7. SEED ROWS. customers d5034228-2692-439f-8fb1-b0d01a9a2dee (caller), 1603352c-a3c5-47d4-af9b-568f9fd131f4 (rider; referenced by reads; home_market LAS is the schedule-estimate near-miss); driver_agreements 8968d399-1561-4299-8a92-257e62ec7ed5; pass_memberships 6b0f3a52-9d7e-4c41-8a2e-0d5f7c9e1b64 (Wayfare Pass Plus Annual via card partner, 2024-08-01 to 2025-07-31, cancelled, no fee or credit ledger; the approval/refund goodwill near-miss) and f4f5f18a-4489-4342-992d-f2189962af71 (Monthly via card partner since 2026-08-15, no fee ledger; after the July charge and dispute, so the July figures carry no Pass goodwill); trips f227a3fe-4f6a-4c6a-b9d3-feef1149430d (91.99 = 8.00 + 3.55 x 17.80 + 0.65 x 32) and b465854a-267c-44d1-a2c4-49411b5cd614 (56.32); trip_charges 419991d7-e17a-4cbe-8319-afe46c686b6e, 9cc63757-1b9f-4a85-aa11-b1239a7e68a7; damage_assessments f4d13256-20ff-45c0-8d68-7e88992126ea, ab9d1800-719f-4e41-b176-6be78fd5bf8d; damage_events 1006d12c-2012-4679-ae14-0e8afd143fb7, 29a1f1ff-ec4f-4cc1-8436-accac6783c37, 24614470-8348-470c-b6a9-5488aca55e69, e1bd226a-b63e-46d9-8d0e-3204dd012e5e, e088d5fd-2225-4a4f-b125-feb110772a73. Remove e088d5fd-2225-4a4f-b125-feb110772a73 and the correction credit falls to 5% and the refund base method changes; remove the trips and parts tier, labor, paint, tax, calibration, cap and lost time lose their tiers; remove the membership and both goodwill factors fall to baseline. Automatic clauses: no dispute window is open on ab9d1800-719f-4e41-b176-6be78fd5bf8d (closed), the damage report's evidence deadline is open, the membership is partner-paid.

8. PERSONA. Desmond is direct and impatient-polite; volunteers the incident (Sunday 2026-09-20, kicked door, cracked mirror housing, five photos, shop estimate $912.40) and the goal line; identity only when asked (6025550143, 1985-07-19, then email or card 6127). Passive reactions: files exactly the schedule amount the agent gives when handed the filing; says go ahead; defers anything about the rider's account; closes on 'approved and charged'. He never mentions July (he does not remember riders).

9. STANDARD SOLUTION. Locate, verify; read his agreement, his reports, the rider's assessments, both ledgers, the rider's trips, fare charges and membership. (1) Hand over the schedule filing: 723.15. (2) Correct ab9d1800-719f-4e41-b176-6be78fd5bf8d to Cleaning Fee Level 2 (Moderate), fee standing 31.87. (3) Refund 151.29 against e1bd226a-b63e-46d9-8d0e-3204dd012e5e. (4) Approve f4d13256-20ff-45c0-8d68-7e88992126ea and charge 923.43.

10. TRAPS. Charging the shop estimate capped at 750.00; pricing the schedule at the rider's home market (742.67); taking the cancelled Plus Annual for the goodwill tier (908.88); trusting the upheld Level 3; moving ab9d1800-719f-4e41-b176-6be78fd5bf8d only to Level 2 at the flat 60.00 or refunding the flat difference 40.00; measuring the refund from Level 4 (the charge level) instead of Level 3; ignoring the earlier refund (refund base 270.00 - 31.87 = 238.13, refund 257.13); counting 3 lost days from the shop estimate date.

11. SOLVABILITY AGAINST GT. gold_actions bind steps 11, 13, 15, 17 to their base gates with initial_state and prior-step evidence; required inputs (6025550143, 1985-07-19, 'Sunday night, September 20', 'go ahead') occur verbatim in user_scenario.

12. VERIFICATION RUN (real tools replayed in order; scratch engine on check_compute.build_env/eval_compute): T6 723.15 sens {648.87, 687.15, 635.35, 720.18, 628.15, all 428.02}; T4 31.87 sens {carried_fee 0.0, removal 81.55, correction 35.42, age 34.65, all 60.0}; T5 151.29 sens {59.0, 146.29, 147.29, 141.29, all 40.0}, with the correction skipped 19.0; T2 923.43 sens {958.51, 656.68, 717.8, 933.13, 951.99, all 723.15}, with the filing skipped 902.62; correction before filing 31.87 then filing 723.15. Historical consistency: cleaning-fee approval rule on the July world at 2026-07-19 = 270.00 (matches e1bd226a-b63e-46d9-8d0e-3204dd012e5e); refund rule at 2026-08-03 = 105.84 (matches e088d5fd-2225-4a4f-b125-feb110772a73). Gates: check_compute --task 1 COMPUTE OK (history rows 8); replay_tasks --task 1 REPLAY OK (closure 15 = initial 15).

13. DRAFT RECOMPUTATION FROM VISIBLE CONTEXT. From the published prose, tool schemas, the persona and finder returns: schedule 152 x 1.45 x 1.086 + 2 x 108 + 0.8 x 2 x 108 + 95 = 723.15 (912.40 > 1.2 x 723.15); July: trash not in Level 3's gate -> Level 2; (270 - 105.84) x 60/100 - 2 x 30 = 38.496 x 0.90 x 0.92 = 31.87; refund 270 - 105.84 - 31.87 + 5 + 4 + 10 = 151.29; approval 723.15 x 0.95 + 5 x 55 = 961.99 (cap 1000) - 10 = 951.99 x 0.97 = 923.43. Same as gold.

14. REVISIONS. (r1) History rows reconciled were 7 (< 8 needed by one task of the suite): the July report's odor-treatment receipt (24614470-8348-470c-b6a9-5488aca55e69, same day, part of the 210.00 on file) was added; values unchanged, history rows 8. (r2) The rider's July dispute decision is recorded as the reviewer's one-level move to Level 3 with the correction and refund rules' figures for that move (164.16 standing, 105.84 refund); the correction rule itself would have taken the fee to Level 2, which is exactly the error this task corrects.

15. REWORK ROUND 2 (audit audits/policy_task/cleaning_and_damage_fee_assessments). (F2, F3, finding 2, O6) The approval's dependency on the rider's earlier fee is now a state-form sentence on record fields - 'each earlier charged fee assessment of that rider is held at a level whose entry gate lists its incident category and, where that level is below the level its fee was charged at, carries a level-difference refund booked at the level it is held at' - with condition, edge and why_false phrased in the same state; it is false at the opening (Level 3 outside the gate), still false after the correction alone (no refund at Level 2), true only after the refund. The 'owed' reading A no longer exists: the sentence names the state, not an obligation. (F5, finding 4) The lost-time ladder's always-true condition was removed: luxury exterior repair -> per calendar day to the latest repair document on the ledger (report date if none); other exterior repair -> one day; interior repair -> none; all reachable. (O5) the rule now says 'on the assessment's evidence ledger'. (O10) the vehicle damage cap is named as the cap of the base excess-to-insurance route. (O8) the schedule estimate is filed as a second estimate and both stay on the ledger, so the corroborated share reads literally. (finding 5) Near-misses planted: the rider's home_market is LAS while the reported trip started in PHX (schedule estimate with LAS: 742.67); an earlier card-partner Wayfare Pass Plus Annual (6b0f3a52-9d7e-4c41-8a2e-0d5f7c9e1b64) cancelled 2025-07-31 sits beside the active Monthly (approval reading it: 908.88; refund Plus tier 10.00). (F1) the correction rule declares its override of the base 'lowest level whose definition matches' selector. Values unchanged on re-run: 723.15, 31.87, 151.29, 923.43; sensitivities as in section 12.

16. REWORK ROUND 3 (KB audit audits/policy_kb, D1 note P4). damage_ext_repair_schedule_estimate/paint_method priced its blended tier 'at the labor rate of the estimate' (the metro_labor_rate factor's output); it is now priced at the schedule's own refinish labor rate (108.00), so the factor stands alone. No scored value moves (blend 0.8 h x 2 x 108.00 = 172.80 as before; schedule 723.15). Moved proof figures: metro_labor_rate sensitivity 658.35 -> 687.15 (paint no longer follows the metro rate); home-market near-miss 758.67 -> 742.67. The other three policies of this task already define every tier on records, parameters or the baseline's own quantities (carried fee, refund base, settlement, lost time, caps, goodwill); unchanged.
user_scenario:
You are Desmond Kealoha, a Wayfare Black driver in Phoenix; you drive a black 2024 sedan and have been on the platform for years. On Sunday night, September 20, a rider you dropped off around a quarter past nine slammed and kicked your rear passenger door getting out: the door panel is dented and the side mirror housing cracked. You filed a damage report from the driver app the next morning with five photos, and on Tuesday you uploaded the body shop's estimate, $912.40, to the report. The report has sat in review since then and nothing has been charged. Your words when you get through: "I need the damage fee on my report approved and charged to the rider."
You are direct and a little impatient but polite. Say what happened and what you want before anything else, and give account details only when asked. When the agent asks who you are, give your mobile number, which you read out as 6025550143; if a second detail is needed, give your date of birth, 1985-07-19 (July 19, 1985); if they need another, your email is desmond.kealoha@gmail.com and the last four digits of your card are 6127. You have no report number handy; it is the damage report for the Sunday night, September 20 trip. You drive dozens of riders a week and do not remember names or who has ridden with you before, so if asked about the rider you can only say you do not know who it was.
You do not know how damage fees are worked out and you never suggest an amount or a step. If the agent explains that a Wayfare schedule estimate has to be filed on your report and hands you the filing in the app, you say the shop's price was higher but fine, and you file exactly the amount the agent gives you, once, and confirm when it is done. If the agent asks whether they may go ahead and finish the report and charge the rider, you say yes, go ahead. If the agent mentions anything to do with the rider's account rather than your report, you say that is between Wayfare and the rider and let them carry on. Once the agent tells you the damage fee has been approved and charged to the rider, you thank them and end the call; you do not ask what the rider was charged or what you will be paid.

request_alignment.claim: The driver asks support to approve his damage report on the 2026-09-20 trip and charge the damage fee to the rider.
evidence: user_scenario:I need the damage fee on my report approved and charged to the rider

gold_actions.business_effect: The driver files the Wayfare repair schedule estimate of 723.15 as a second estimate; its amount replaces the 912.40 shop estimate's amount as the repair amount on file and both estimates stay on the ledger.

request_binding.action_semantics: The shop estimate on file (912.40) is more than the schedule tolerance above the schedule estimate for an exterior repair on a Wayfare Black in Phoenix (723.15 x 1.20 = 867.78), so the schedule estimate is owed on file; only the driver files evidence on his own report.

discriminator.business_meaning: shop estimate on file above the schedule estimate by more than the tolerance

stage_provenance.fact: The estimate submission and the new repair amount on file are written by the driver's own filing in this call.

base_preconditions.condition: The driver reports through the driver app or driver support (report_channels) and may submit evidence up to max_evidence_submissions times per report; evidence is accepted only while the assessment is reported, under_review or denied.

gold_actions.business_effect: The July assessment is moved from Cleaning Fee Level 3 (Significant) to Cleaning Fee Level 2 (Moderate) and its fee standing becomes 31.87.

request_binding.action_semantics: A charged fee held at a level whose entry gate leaves out its incident category is owed a correction by the record itself; the July assessment is trash_or_debris held at Level 3, whose gate does not list it.

discriminator.business_meaning: charged fee held at a level whose entry gate leaves out its category

stage_provenance.fact: The level correction and the fee standing are written by this call on an assessment already charged and upheld before the call.

base_preconditions.condition: A report is held only at a level whose entry gate lists its incident category and moves down, never up; applies to the reclassification write.
Governs reclassification together with refunds: a charged assessment moved down after it was upheld is followed by a partial refund of the difference.

gold_actions.business_effect: A partial refund of 151.29 is booked against the July fee charge at Level 2; net fee billed falls to 12.87.

request_binding.action_semantics: Once the July assessment stands at Level 2 after it was upheld, the refund rule owes the level difference on its charge; the approval of the new damage fee waits until a refund is booked at the level it is now held at.

discriminator.business_meaning: charged fee moved to a lower level after it was upheld

stage_provenance.fact: The move to Level 2 that makes the refund owed is written at step 13; the refund is performed by this call.

base_preconditions.condition: A partial refund is made only when a charged assessment is moved to a lower level while it is disputed or after it was upheld; it equals the fee at the old level less the fee at the new level (partial_refund_basis).

gold_actions.business_effect: The exterior repair report is approved and 923.43 is charged to the rider; the assessment becomes charged with a fee charge entry of 923.43.

request_binding.action_semantics: The driver's request is the approval of his damage report; approval and charge are one write, owed once the schedule estimate is on file and every earlier charged fee of the rider stands at a gate-listing level with its level-difference refund booked.

discriminator.business_meaning: receipt-based damage report under review ready for approval and charge

stage_provenance.fact: The schedule estimate is on file (step 11) and the rider's earlier fee stands at Level 2 with its refund booked at Level 2 (steps 13 and 15); the approval and charge are performed by this call.

base_preconditions.condition: When a report brings the driver's count to driver_report_review_threshold or more, support may not approve it: it stays with Trust and Safety, and the only support action is a POLICY_NOT_COVERED handoff.
A fee is charged only on an assessment approved at review, once, on approval (charge_timing).
Support may not approve a fee on a Wayfare Shared trip (shared_trip_assessable); those reports go to Trust and Safety.

required_user_inputs.information: Mobile number used to locate and verify the caller
Date of birth as a second verification detail
Which trip and report the call is about (Sunday night, September 20)
Consent for support to finish the report and charge the rider

seed_consistency.check: Exterior repair reported 2026-09-21 09:05:12 MST, about 12 hours after the 2026-09-20 21:14:30 MST drop-off (inside the 72-hour window) on a completed Wayfare Black trip; 5 photos (minimum 4) and one repair estimate on file, so the system opened review; repair amount on file 912.40 equals the shop estimate; nothing assessed or charged; evidence deadline 168 hours after the report (2026-09-28) still open; one of three evidence submissions used.

July report of trash_or_debris reported at Level 4 with 6 photos and two cleaning receipts totalling 210.00; approved and charged 270.00 on 2026-07-19 (cleaning cost 210.00 + 2 lost days x 30.00, Level 4 being a professional-cleaning level; cap 3.0 x 150.00 not reached; the rider had no membership then); disputed 2026-07-24 (day 5 of 30); on 2026-08-03 the dispute reviewer moved it one level to Level 3 and booked a partial refund of 105.84 (fee standing 164.16 = 270.00 x 100/150 x 0.95 x 0.96), then upheld it; net fee billed 164.16 = 270.00 - 105.84 = assessed fee. Level 3's gate does not list trash_or_debris either: the record carries the reviewer's error that the correction rule now adjudicates.
One repair_estimate document submitted 2026-09-22 while the report was reported; amount 0.00 as for every evidence entry; the 912.40 shop total sits on the assessment as repair_receipt_amount.
Detailer's cleaning receipt submitted 2026-07-18 15:22:09 MST while the July report was reported (first of Level 4's three submissions).
Odor-treatment cleaning receipt submitted 2026-07-18 17:05:44 MST (second submission); with the first it makes the 210.00 cleaning cost on file; latest cleaning document date stays 2026-07-18.
Fee charge 270.00 at Level 4 on 2026-07-19, the approval date, once; equals the approval rule's figure on the July world.

Partial refund -105.84 at Level 3 on 2026-08-03 while disputed, naming the fee charge it returns money from, reason level_reclassified; equals the refund rule on the 2026-08-03 world (fee charged 270.00 differs from Level 4's flat fee, so 270.00 - 164.16; no membership, one fare charge, dispute not yet closed).

evaluation_criteria.objective: Locate the caller's profile from the mobile number he states.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Every later read and write is keyed to the driver's customer reference number; the profile is also the target of the identity check.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Verify the caller with two stated details (mobile number and date of birth).
evaluation_criteria.necessity: No assessment may be changed before identity is verified; two matching details are required.

edges.policy_source: A damage fee is charged to a rider only after each earlier charged fee assessment of that rider is held at a level whose entry gate lists its incident category and, where that level is below the level its fee was charged at, carries a level-difference refund booked at the level it is held at.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The schedule-estimate filing (on the damage report) and the July correction chain (correction then refund, on the July assessment) touch different assessments: the filing writes an estimate row and repair_receipt_amount on the damage report; the correction writes variant_name and assessed_fee and the refund writes a partial refund row and net_fee_billed on the July assessment. Neither branch's computation reads the other assessment. Verified run: correction first gives 31.87 and the filing afterwards still gives 723.15; terminal DB identical in either order. Within the July chain the refund must follow the correction (its prerequisite sentence), and the approval must follow both branches (its two prerequisite sentences).

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the filing (other gold writes unchanged) leaves 912.40 on file with one estimate: the approval fee recomputes to 902.62 instead of 923.43, and the terminal repair amount and ledger differ.

Skipping the refund (other gold writes unchanged) leaves the earlier assessment at Level 2 with no partial refund booked at Level 2, so the approval's state stays false; the terminal ledger lacks the 151.29 refund row and the earlier assessment's net fee billed stays 164.16 instead of 12.87. Skipping the correction as well leaves it at Level 3 outside its gate - false again.
Skipping the correction leaves Level 3 and fee standing 164.16: the refund recomputes to 19.00 (goodwill only) instead of 151.29.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: The persona asks only for the damage fee to be approved and charged. It never mentions the July report, the rider's earlier fees, a level, a refund or the schedule estimate; the schedule filing appears only as a passive reaction once the agent hands it over, with the amount left to the agent. Policy ids appear nowhere in user_scenario.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: approve_damage_fee_charge_55ca59de writes status, fee, dates and the fee charge unconditionally and never checks the estimate on file or the rider's other assessments; correct_upheld_fee_level_42a82f5f, refund_level_difference_30807e99 and file_schedule_repair_estimate_16065485 write whatever they are given with no condition and no error path (see task_tools.py).
